title: Create the periodontal maintenance reminder
summary: Alert rule that warns (and can message the patient) when maintenance is due.

steps.title: Menu → System → Alert Rules
steps.details: What creates an alert and when.

steps.title: Name
steps.details: How it shows in the Alerts Center.

steps.title: Code
steps.details: A unique code for the rule.

steps.title: Category
steps.details: The Alerts Center group, for example the one for patient reminders.

steps.title: Source
steps.details: The v_alert_perio_maintenance view: one row per patient with their latest closed chart and the date maintenance is due.

steps.title: ID field
steps.details: “id”: it is the patient (so the automatic sending knows who to message).

steps.title: Condition
steps.details: Add one: column due_date, operator “=” and value {{TODAY}}. Without it the rule does not filter by date.

steps.title: Days before the event
steps.details: How far ahead to warn: with 14, the alert comes 14 days before maintenance.

steps.title: Recurrence
steps.details: Daily: every day it looks for the maintenance that is due.

steps.title: WhatsApp template (optional)
steps.details: To message the patient: a patient-type template. Sending is turned on by “Send SMS automatically”.

steps.title: Email template (optional)
steps.details: With “Send email automatically” and the global alert email switch. Only patient and clinic variables.

steps.title: Save
steps.details: From the next day, the alert engine creates a warning for each patient whose maintenance is due.
